assumptions: Host behavior matches the SPEC-054 research of 2026-10-24; portable-server users exist under the installer default key; an alias window counted in releases is acceptable for an alpha package; prompt use is not measurable.
compatibility: New portable surface contract agent-braid-tooling/v0.2 (additive names, retained deprecated aliases, capabilities keys envelopeSchemaVersion and deprecatedPrompts); unchanged under the recommended scope: envelope schema v0.1, tool names, resource URIs, agent-braid-plugin/v0.2, registry v0.2, SPEC-047 v1, SPEC-041/042 installs and frozen evidence. Aliases are removed by a later v0.3.
domain: Agent Braid portable MCP server (agent-braid tooling serve, package 0.1.0a1) and its prompt and capabilities surface; the native plugin, telemetry, legacy skills and host configuration only as unchanged regression boundaries.
execution_contract: No execution path, grant, effect or runtime authority changes; prompts remain read-only text; analysis-only fixtures suffice; native sessions are owner-run.
hypotheses: Not applicable: engineering specification without empirical hypothesis.
observation_contract: SDK client listings of prompts and capabilities in owned fixtures, byte comparison of envelopes against the v0.1 candidate, plugin goldens; native host listings recorded separately with environment and limits.

scenarios.given: a v0.2 server and an SDK client
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_001 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: all three are listed, each result carries exactly the v0.1 message text of its predecessor, an unknown name is refused with no side effect, and an oversized argument map is refused as in v0.1.
scenarios.when: the client lists prompts and requests `analyze`, `plan` and `evidence`

requirements.text: Unprefixed canonical prompts: The v0.2 portable server lists and serves the prompts `analyze`, `plan` and `evidence`. Their message text equals the v0.1 text of the corresponding `agent-braid-*` prompt byte for byte.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_002 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the listing orders canonical names before aliases, every alias description starts with the deprecation marker and names its replacement, each alias returns the canonical message text, and the capabilities resource lists the aliases under `deprecatedPrompts` and not under `prompts`.
scenarios.when: prompts are listed and each alias is requested

requirements.text: Bounded deprecated aliases: The old names `agent-braid-analyze`, `agent-braid-plan` and `agent-braid-evidence` remain requestable and listed as deprecated aliases of the canonical prompts during a defined window, and only there. The alias message text equals the canonical text; only the list description and the result description state the deprecation, the canonical replacement and the contract version that removes the alias. The policy exception is defined in the contract: it applies to the portable server's prompts only, never to the plugin server, tools, skills or resources, and never extends silently.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_003 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: envelopes, output schemas and provenance equal the v0.1 server's byte-for-byte on identical inputs, and the capabilities resource reports `schemaVersion` `agent-braid-tooling/v0.2` and `envelopeSchemaVersion` `agent-braid-tooling/v0.1`.
scenarios.when: every tool is invoked and every resource is read

requirements.text: Scope of the version change: The contract version `agent-braid-tooling/v0.2` identifies the server surface (capabilities resource, prompt set, contract document). The tool-result envelope schema, its `schemaVersion` stamp (`agent-braid-tooling/v0.1`), the tool output schemas, the provenance block and the resource URIs are unchanged. The capabilities resource reports both identifiers so a client can tell the surface from the envelope. (Alternative A, stamping v0.2 everywhere, is recorded as OD-1 with its effects.)

scenarios.given: a plugin connection with two registered workspaces
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_004 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the prompts capability is absent, both requests are refused without side effects, the capabilities resources contain neither `prompts` nor `deprecatedPrompts` nor `envelopeSchemaVersion`, and every other output equals the alpha.4 output.
scenarios.when: it initializes, lists prompts, requests a canonical name and an alias, reads each `capabilities` resource and invokes each tool on identical inputs

requirements.text: Plugin facade unchanged: The plugin MCP server still advertises no prompts capability and returns no prompts. Its tool envelopes (`agent-braid-plugin/v0.2`, including the nested core provenance), its per-workspace capabilities resource and its tool, resource and permission names are byte-identical to the alpha.4 behavior, although it derives from the same core.

scenarios.given: the existing suites for telemetry, legacy install, host configuration, the plugin and the System One verifier
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_005 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: they pass, a prompt request records no telemetry operation, and a previewed host configuration is byte-identical to the v0.1 preview.
scenarios.when: they run against the v0.2 candidate with only the intentional prompt and capabilities assertions changed

requirements.text: Dependent contracts unchanged: Keep unchanged: the tool names, including the nine plugin tool names; the SPEC-047 `mcp` operation enum, batch and store contracts (prompts are not counted); the receipt-owned legacy global skill install and its `agent-braid-*` skill names; the host configuration written by `tooling configure|install|update` (server key, command and arguments); and the System One verifier that checks the envelope stamp.

scenarios.given: a host configuration written by the v0.1 installer
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_006 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the same configuration starts the v0.2 server, both names resolve, and after reinstalling the earlier package the old names resolve and the new names are refused, with the host configuration and any result roots unchanged.
scenarios.when: the package is updated to the candidate and the host reconnects

requirements.text: Migration and rollback for registered portable servers: A user who registered the portable server needs no configuration change to adopt v0.2, keeps working invocations of the old names during the window, and can roll back by reinstalling the earlier package. The documentation states the Claude Code display forms before and during the window, that Codex does not display MCP prompts, and the host-key collision caveat of REQ-010.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_007 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: a missing release count, release note, owner decision or repository-reference check blocks the removal, and the document states that non-use is unmeasured.
scenarios.when: the removal criterion is read against a proposed removal

requirements.text: Window and removal criterion: The window is the first release that carries v0.2 plus one more release (N = 2 releases, an OD-2 proposal). Aliases are removed by a later contract version, `agent-braid-tooling/v0.3`, only when every criterion in the contract holds; the window never extends silently, and usage is not a criterion because prompt traffic is not measured.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_008 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: it names the package version, the contract versions, the exact list of changed and unchanged surfaces, the migration and rollback notes, and states that no release, tag or publication was performed or authorized.

requirements.text: Release and versioning impact: Name the carrier and the effects without authorizing a release: the Python package version and `serverInfo.version` (proposed `0.1.0a2`), the contract identifier, the absence of a required plugin release or plugin schema change, and the release notes content (new names, alias window, removal contract, rollback).

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_009 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the unprefixed names appear as primary, every `agent-braid-*` prompt mention is marked deprecated or historical, and no document claims Codex displays MCP prompts or that the plugin publishes prompts.
scenarios.when: it is searched for prompt names

requirements.text: Documentation: English documentation shows the new names as the primary invocation, marks the old names deprecated, links the contract and the removal criterion, and amends the SPEC-054 naming-policy rule on deprecated aliases by pointer, without rewriting SPEC-054's accepted files.

scenarios.given: the source-bound candidate registered as a portable server under the default key and, separately, alongside the native plugin
scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_010 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: the observed names match the contract table, the observation records whether the portable prompt `/agent-braid:analyze (MCP)` and the plugin skill `/agent-braid:analyze` can be confused, and the outcome, environment and limits are recorded separately from package checks.

requirements.text: Host observation and the key-collision caveat: Observe the v0.2 portable server in a real Claude Code profile (and record that Codex lists no prompts) before any release, including the case where both the native plugin and the portable server are installed.

scenarios.planned_evidence: Candidate-bound procedure_011 record: command, hashes, environment, expected and actual outcome, negative controls and limits.
scenarios.then: no file under a frozen evidence path, no SPEC-054 file and no accepted ADR is modified, and the v0.1 contract text remains available as history.
scenarios.when: paths are compared with the frozen inventory

requirements.text: Frozen evidence untouched: No frozen historical evidence, closed receipt, accepted review or SPEC-040/046/054 artifact is rewritten. The prompt names inside them remain true for their candidates.

scientific_limits: Engineering naming and versioning contract; no scientific claim. Planned procedures are not obtained evidence; documentation and source reading are not native observation; structural checks are not owner approval.
scope: Portable MCP server contract agent-braid-tooling/v0.2: unprefixed prompt names analyze, plan, evidence with bounded deprecated agent-braid-* aliases, version-stamp scope, plugin/telemetry/legacy/host impact, migration, rollback, removal criterion and release impact. Specification only.
